warnings.detail: the minimal PDF structure (page objects, xref offsets, trailer) is hand-rolled — the single most bug-prone part of this leaf
warnings.rationale: stdlib has no PDF writer and vendoring the shim is an explicit task (A-SHIM-VENDOR); xref offset bugs are the expected failure mode, which is why AT02 counts page objects in the saved bytes

warnings.detail: app/api.py is an existing shared file; the amendment must leave handle_export_csv behaviorally unchanged
warnings.rationale: acceptance A4 requires the pre-existing CSV suite to stay green; the risk is regression, not new-code difficulty

inevitable for a cross-leaf consistency pass — each contract is a re-read point by construction; splitting the pass into per-contract tasks would multiply the overhead without shrinking any single closure, so it stays one read-only leaf

warnings.detail: p80 (75-120 min) can exceed the stage leaf_p80_max of 90 min
warnings.rationale: seam defects discovered at wiring time are open-ended; if execution exceeds p80 the correct move is checkpoint_and_split around the single defect (the composition module itself is thin and stable)
fix rights are deliberately limited to seam lines and every patch is recorded as a deviation in the checkpoint, so local recoverability of the leaves is preserved

warnings.detail: p80 (60-120 min) can exceed the stage leaf_p80_max of 90 min
warnings.rationale: the e2e task is not splittable in any useful way (gates share the ServiceApp fixture); if it exceeds p80 the scope to reduce is the gate count (E5 full-suite rerun can be delegated to CI), not the closure semantics

warnings.detail: e2e drives a real in-process worker thread
warnings.rationale: tests use a bounded polling loop (max ~10s) instead of fixed sleeps so a slow worker fails loudly with the last observed status as evidence instead of flaking
